stories.title: Tool Routing Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define strict Pydantic schemas and routing contracts for all allowlisted tools, ensuring consistent input validation and typed interfaces between router and tool handlers.

stories.title: Allowlist Configuration and Enforcement Layer
stories.description: Implement centralized allowlist configuration defining which tools are permitted, and enforce checks within the router before any dispatch occurs.

stories.title: Disallowed Tool and Validation Failure Handling
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling for disallowed tools and invalid inputs, returning safe, structured responses without executing any unauthorized logic.

stories.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
stories.description: Integrate debug logging and traceability into tool routing decisions, including allowlist checks, validation outcomes, and dispatch results for monitoring and QA.
